name: Waldorf Astoria Costa Rica Punta Cacique

address.street: KM 3 Ruta Nacional 159 Playa Penca Guanacaste

insider_take: This isn't just luxury—it's Costa Rica's first Waldorf Astoria, where rainforest meets refined elegance on one of the world's most biodiverse peninsulas.
whats_special: Perched on Peninsula Papagayo's dramatic cliffs, this resort sits within a 1,400-acre nature preserve where howler monkeys wake you at dawn and scarlet macaws paint the sky. The property features Costa Rica's only Jack Nicklaus signature golf course and offers direct access to four pristine beaches, each with distinct personalities—from calm Cacique Bay to adventurous Nacascolo.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the Spa by Waldorf Astoria during late afternoon—the treatment rooms overlook the forest canopy where wildlife is most active, creating a natural soundtrack for your relaxation.
dont_miss: The resort's signature "Pura Vida" sunset experience from Cacique Point, where you can spot whales during migration season (July-November). Also explore the peninsula's 11 miles of hiking trails that lead to hidden archaeological sites dating back 10,000 years, making this one of Central America's most significant pre-Columbian locations.
pros: Iconic Waldorf Astoria luxury standards with personalized service
Stunning Peninsula Papagayo location with pristine beaches
Exceptional dining experiences with local Costa Rican flavors
cons: Remote peninsula location requires planning for off-property activities
